title: docs: narrative cost — 42.5% of source lines are comments, workflows 58.6%, AGENTS.md is 103 KB with three stale claims, ROADMAP.md still says v3.3.2 and 80 Storybook stories
body:
Ruled: 6435359095 · letter A for PR 2 (prior 6386217274 A) · 2026-10-27T06:34Z

## 维护者速读

全仓非测试源码 643,658 行里 **273,486 行是注释（42.5 %）**，`packages/types/src` 69.6 %；`.github/workflows` 11,342 行里 58.6 % 是 `#`；**24,922 行源码引用 issue 号，涉及 3,186 个不同的 objectui 卡**。`AGENTS.md` 103 KB / 630 行，§9 运维叙事占 66 %，含 3 处过期声明；`ROADMAP.md` 1,899 行停在「May 6 2026 · v3.3.2 · 80 Storybook stories」（仓里没有 Storybook）。仓库几乎全由 AI 席位写入，叙事是每个会话的强制 token 成本，也是受管面每次改动的复审成本。建议：规范核心与事故史分家，注释写不变量不写事故史，存量不横扫。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; comment lines matched by the pattern "optional whitespace then // or /* or *")

- Non-test source (packages + console, excluding locale packs): 643,658 lines, 273,486 comment (42.5 %), 337,531 code. Excluding `packages/types`: 39.5 %. `packages/types/src` alone: 45,265 of 64,991 (69.6 %). Tests: 1,225,145 lines, 27.7 % comments. `scripts/*.mjs`: 99,378 lines, 43.1 %. Workflows: 6,651 of 11,342 lines are `#` (`ci.yml` 1,688 of 2,868; `changeset-release.yml` 1,091 of 1,545 = 70 %). Root configs (eslint, vitest, tsconfig*, turbo): 67.1 %.
- Issue citations in non-test source: 24,922 lines match `objectui#NNNN|objectstack#NNNN|#NNNN+`; 3,186 distinct `objectui#` numbers. 86 test files pin workflow prose; 678 reference `AGENTS.md`.
- `AGENTS.md`: 103,232 bytes, 630 lines; §9 "Operational Rules" is 66 % of the code points; 107 distinct issue citations, 16 dated rulings, 72 ⛔ markers; 15 scripts and 10 `pnpm` commands are named as re-deriving instruments against roughly 90 prose-only paragraphs; 33 commits in 49 days. Stale claims inside the governed file: the "Local dev" section says `framework` serves the published console from `packages/console/dist` (no such directory; the console is `apps/console`); the "能 push 分支，却删不掉远端 ref" bullet says the container has no `gh` CLI (`which gh` → `/usr/local/bin/gh`, and the merge-queue section instructs `gh pr merge --auto`); the "依赖与锁文件" section says overrides point to `file:node_modules/.cache/objectstack/<name>` while `package.json` and the lockfile say `file:.objectstack-pin/<name>` (moved by objectui#13008); "39 个包一起发" versus 40 entries in the fixed group.
- `ROADMAP.md`: 1,899 lines; header "Last Updated: May 6, 2026 · Current Published Version: v3.3.2 · Spec Version: @objectstack/spec ^4.0.4" against the real 18.0.0; claims "80 Storybook stories" — no `.storybook` directory or dependency anywhere (positive control: `tailwind-merge` found). `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` is the 2026-04 app-shell extraction guide; 31 of its lines are byte-identical to `docs/CONSOLE-STREAMLINING-SUMMARY.md`. `.github/prompts/` (three Copilot prompt files, 624 lines, naming Framer Motion, 0 dependencies) sits outside every doc gate's scan roots although `AGENTS.md` declares itself the single instruction file. `docs/adr` has 11 files, no index; the tree cites 96 distinct ADR numbers (ADR-0049 1,321 times) that resolve only in objectstack.
- A concrete collision this style produces: `scripts/__tests__/changeset-release-action-ref-pin.test.ts` pins the `changesets/action` SHA in prose while `.github/dependabot.yml` groups weekly `github-actions` bumps; run 40054697521's `Test (shard 8/16)` went red on it.

## Recommendation

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` to a normative core of at most about 250 lines: each rule once, with its instrument pointer (`pnpm check:*` / test name), no incident narrative; move the incident write-ups (stash collision, ref delete, FETCH_HEAD, GitHub byte rewriting, workflow registry) into `docs/postmortems/` or the governed `.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/`; move the local-dev / port / multi-stack procedure into `console-development.md`; fix the three stale claims in the same PR. (Governed surface.)
- [ ] Workflows and scripts: a comment budget — one line of why plus a link; rationale lives in the ADR or the issue. Re-measure with the pattern above.
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` cut to at most 40 lines pointing at milestones and labels (drop its `SCAN_ROOTS` row in `check-doc-links.mjs`); delete `docs/CONSOLE-STREAMLINING-SUMMARY.md` and `.github/prompts/`; rename `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` to what it is or fold it into `content/docs/guide/architecture-overview.md`; add a 20-line `docs/adr/README.md` saying numbers are allocated in objectstack.
- [ ] Exempt `changesets/action` from the Dependabot group or have the pin test read the SHA from the one place both share.
- [ ] Code comments going forward: invariants, not incident history (the history stays on the PR / issue). Existing comments are not swept — this is a rule for new writing, and it argues against part of the current objectstack-ai/objectui#9 / objectstack-ai/objectui#11 practice, so it is the maintainer's call.

Benefit: roughly 20k fewer tokens of mandatory context per agent session (token count is 未实测 — a tokenizer over `AGENTS.md` settles it); thousands fewer governed lines to re-approve per workflow change; the pin-versus-prose class of red disappears.

Refs: objectui#7833, objectui#7800, objectui#12255, objectui#13008.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ~~⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.~~ Ruled; see the first line.
